items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Cnd Choo was an enormous man. He weighed 260, you know, and was all man. Do you remember the time that he was playing with Calloway...

ctx.x: Yes, his skull was crushed on one side.

That's right. And he got to the hospital, and Cnd Choo was an enormous man. He weighed 260, you know, and was all man. Do you remember the time that he was playing with Calloway and he took Calloway by the arm and took him all the way down the back of the bus.
